messages:
Ava Roberts: Quick heads-up 020202 All-Hands this Wed 11:00 PT (Zoom). Agenda draft: 1) CEO update + hiring progress (7m) 2) Dedicated GA launch callout + migration notes (10m) 3) Data retention defaults policy update (5m) 4) Runtime batching demo + perf numbers (8m) 5) Roadmap snapshot (5m) 6) Live AMA (20m). Please add questions here or use the intake form: https://forms.gle/ai-allhands-intake


townhall-bot: Event created 024-11-15  11:00 PT  Zoom link already in calendar invite. Reminder set for 24h and 15m before.


Samir Khan: For the Dedicated GA slide, i'm including migration steps and a simple rollback playbook. Can we allocate 3 minutes in the demo slot for mitigation procedures?


Olivia Park: I'll own the policy slide. Short summary: default retention reduces from 90 -> 30 days for non-enterprise tenants; enterprise customers can set custom retention via settings or contact support for contracts. Legal reviewed the notice language.


LegalBot: Flag: send customer notice 7 days prior to change. Action: ProductOps to finalize copy for mass-email and support KB.


Ava Roberts: Good catch. @LegalBot can you paste the suggested one-liner we'll use in the email? also @DesignOps please add the two diagrams explaining migration options.


DesignOps: Copy suggestion and diagram draft posted here: https://drive.example.com/designs/allhands-dedicated-migration.jpg


Samir Khan: Demo plan: show continuous batching + KV cache hit rate improvement. Command i'll run: `rdw serve --model redwood-v2 --batching=continuous --kv-cache=true --loadtest=500qps` Will also have a local replay script for folks to run.


Olivia Park: Accessibility note: enable live captions and record transcript (VTT) so we can attach it to the confluence page. Also will compile a short FAQ for the Dedicated pricing Qs.


Ava Roberts: Please drop final slides by Tue 6pm PT. We'll do a dry run Wed 9:30 PT. Recording link will be posted in #all-hands-recordings and Confluence within 2 hours after the meeting.


Samir Khan: added rehearsal to my calendar. putting the rollback steps into a gist and will paste link here after rehearsal.


Olivia Park: Qs already in this thread: retention opt-out for orgs? how will Dedicated billing be prorated? who to contact for bespoke SLAs? please add anything else. We'll prioritize these in the AMA.


Ava Roberts: Thanks all  please RSVP on the invite. If you need to present but cannot make the rehearsal, ping me and we'll record a short voiceover. See you Wednesday!
